summary:
Results-driven Senior Full Stack Software Developer with 9+ years of expertise in enterprise software development across the entire technology stack. Proven track record of delivering high-performance, scalable full-stack solutions in fintech and enterprise systems. Core competencies include:

• Full Stack Development: Expert in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud) backend and Angular (primary), React.js, Vue.js frontend development
• Back-End Expertise: RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSocket, Microservices Architecture, Enterprise Integration Patterns
• Front-End Expertise: Angular 2-15+, TypeScript, RxJS, State Management (NGXS/NgRx for Angular, Redux for React, Pinia for Vue), React.js, Next.js, Vue.js
• Testing & Quality: Comprehensive testing with Jest, Cypress, Playwright, React Testing Library achieving high code coverage
• Database Engineering: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Oracle, MySQL, Redis with optimization and performance tuning
• DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, CI/CD automation, Monitoring and Analytics
• Technical Leadership: Led and mentored development teams, driving innovation and best practices

Key Achievements:
• Developed full-stack solutions for payment processing platform handling $100M+ annual transactions
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to reduce system response time by 45% through microservices implementation
• Improved application performance by 60% through technical optimization and coding best practices
• Led and mentored teams of 8+ developers, achieving 95% sprint completion rate
• Implemented secure payment solutions compliant with PCI-DSS standards
